guide.title: Where do the numbers come from? (scope: orders with PRODUCTION ENTRY DATE in the filtered range, assigned to a designer; excludes cancelled + unmapped-factory orders)
guide.designer: Active accounts with the Designer role. Badge = rank from this range's score (S≥85 · A≥70 · B≥55 · C≥40 · D<40).
guide.score: 0-100 score from 6 parts: Speed 30 + Quality 25 + Throughput 15 + Response 10 + Reliability 10 + Initiative 10. Click "Guide" for a walkthrough with examples.
guide.trend: Compared with the immediately preceding range of the same length (e.g. filtering 7 days → vs the 7 days before). — means one of the two ranges lacks data.
guide.componentsCol: The 5 score components. Donut: colored part = points earned, gray = missing to 100. Hover for details.
guide.speed: Total actual work time (clock runs from "Start" to "Complete", accumulated across reworks) VS the team's average time on the SAME product types — hard products don't penalize you.
guide.quality: Share of done orders NOT sent back for rework due to a designer error.
guide.throughput: Orders completed in range vs the team median.
guide.response: Time from being ASSIGNED to first pressing "Start", vs team median — faster pickup scores higher.
guide.reliability: Penalized per "can't do" handoff over total assigned orders.
guide.done: Completed orders / total orders assigned in range (all statuses).
guide.level: OFFICIAL level set by Admin (S-D select). The "Suggest" chip = rank from the last 60 days' score — click to apply. Used later for hard/easy task routing.
guide.scope: At least {{minDone}} done orders in range are required for an official rank — below that, "not enough data" is shown and the badge is dimmed.
guide.proactive: Counts SELF-clicks of "Claim for me" in the assign backlog/drill panel (leader assignments do NOT count; by click time). Zero claims = neutral 50; matching the claimers' median = 75; double = 100.

performance.formulaProactive: • Initiative 10% — self "Claim for me" count (reward only, no penalty)

guideDialog.title: How to read this ranking
guideDialog.intro: Each designer gets a 0-100 score for the filtered date range. Higher = more effective. A score of 50 means right at the team average — no better, no worse than anyone.

speed.name: Speed
speed.how: Compares your time per order with the team's average time on the SAME product types — so taking hard products never hurts you.
speed.ex: Team averages 60 minutes per Hoodie order. You take 30 (twice as fast) → full 30 pts. Exactly 60 → 15 pts. 120+ minutes → 0 pts.

quality.name: Quality
quality.how: Counts done orders that got sent back for rework.
quality.ex: 100 done, 10 sent back → 90% → 22.5/25 pts. None sent back → full 25 pts.

throughput.name: Throughput
throughput.how: Compares your completed count with the middle person of the team (half do more, half do less).
throughput.ex: Middle person finishes 20 orders. You finish 20 → 7.5 pts. 40+ → full 15 pts.

response.name: Response
response.how: From being assigned to first pressing "Start", vs the team's middle person.
response.ex: Team usually starts 30 minutes after assignment. You start after 15 → twice as fast → full 10 pts.

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.how: Each "can't do" handoff to someone else deducts points.
reliability.ex: 50 assigned, zero handoffs → full 10 pts. 5 of 50 handed off → −10% → 9 pts.

proactive.name: Initiative
proactive.how: Counts times you SELF-click "Claim for me" in the assign backlog. Leader assignments don't count. Bonus only — never a penalty.
proactive.ex: Never self-claim → still 5/10 pts (no penalty). Claim at the claimers' baseline → 7.5. Double it → full 10.

notes.scope: Only orders ENTERING PRODUCTION within the filtered dates count (cancelled and unmapped-factory orders excluded). Initiative counts by click time.
notes.minDone: Fewer than {{minDone}} done in range → "not enough data", dimmed badge — the score is indicative only.
notes.trend: Trend column: points gained/lost vs the immediately preceding range of the same length.
notes.level: Official level is the Admin's call — the "Suggest" chip is just computed from the last 60 days' score.
